notes.title: Meta Soulmate Early Access 0.2.0 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]Meta Soulmate Early Access 0.2.0 Update Announcement[/b][/h1]

Hello, this is the Meta Soulmate Team.
We’re excited to announce the release of the second major version, [b]Early Access 0.2.0[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/f4e8b93b5e8d57f1a36b5f2dcb0c5b4c332494af.jpg[/img]

This update introduces the new V-DNA character, [b]Sol[/b], alongside various outfits, accessories, and new features.

[h2][b]🆕 New V-DNA Sol Added[/b][/h2]
Introducing the new base character, [b]Sol[/b]!
Sol is a small, anthropomorphic character offering a unique charm unlike any of the existing characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/3a4a7167159a8aacf8b2cce00870552efc8071c8.png[/img]

[h2][b]🧢 New Accessory Slots Added[/b][/h2]
A total of [b]4 new accessories[/b] – glasses and necklaces – have been added.
These items are fixed in position, allowing for a variety of stylish combinations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/0b6bcf5619afe59f76c6844037d921685f217035.png[/img]

[h2][b]👗 Additional Outfits, Hair, and Accessories[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Common Additions[/b][/h3]
[b]3 dynamic accessories[/b] have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/a8bd348305a7b69ac86728e3eb5635db00cb8537.png[/img]

[h3][b]Zennah[/b][/h3]
[b]3 tops[/b], [b]2 dresses[/b], and [b]3 hairstyles[/b] have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/441c3d46826682aa3c8550e0b32f130fa466faa0.png[/img]

[h3][b]Bibi[/b][/h3]
[b]1 top[/b] and [b]1 hairstyle[/b] have been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/8de7c1e1ac04c08d873ee3508f875bc83c67dd03.png[/img]

[h3][b]Zio[/b][/h3]
[b]1 hairstyle[/b] has been added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/26ca4094f27d49d270fabcde70bbc0e96dc38f2f.png[/img]

[h2][b]📸 Photo Mode Added[/b][/h2]
You can now apply various screen effects and take screenshots via the [b]Studio → Picture[/b] menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/1067889f084f33808243b74729d212630cf0efd0.png[/img]

[h2][b]🎥 New Streaming Tutorial Added[/b][/h2]
To help you easily start virtual broadcasting, we’ve added a [b]simple tutorial[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/b80a7796ed9acb6e653bb97c8b908c55dac0297c.png[/img]

[h2][b]🛠 Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
We’ve fixed various bugs and improved the overall usability of some features.

We’re committed to making Meta Soulmate an even better experience.
Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

Sincerely,
The Meta Soulmate Team

notes.title: Meta Soulmate 0.1.2 Minor Update and Free Membership Coupon Announcement
notes.content:
[h2][b]Meta Soulmate 0.1.2 Minor Update and Free Membership Coupon Announcement[/b][/h2]

Hello, this is the Meta Soulmate team!  
We are pleased to introduce some exciting new benefits and important updates for our character customization and VTuber tools.

[h3][b]Free Membership Coupon[/b][/h3]
We’re offering a 7-day free membership coupon for new users!  
Simply enter [b]META SOULMATE[/b] in the coupon input field, which can be accessed via the pop-up displayed at app launch or by clicking the banner under Settings, and enjoy all features.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/335ec62d419ddb26fd2470bf28f80325b501a533.png[/img]

[list]
[*] This free coupon does not require any payment method for activation.
[*] After the 7-day free period ends, membership benefits will stop, but no additional charges will occur.
[*] Existing subscribers can use this coupon once their current subscription ends.
[/list]

[h3][b]Meta Screen Usage Time Limit Removed[/b][/h3]
Free users can now enjoy unlimited use of Meta Screen!  
The previous 30-minute daily time restriction for free users has been fully removed. Feel free to stream as much as you like!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/fd6d46135dc27f0878ee0d5d2d90ba19800991f0.png[/img]

[h3][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h3]
We have refined the UI to enhance clarity and make it easier to distinguish certain elements.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/f1635e4c3314ae50489eb335d2144ae6d3265665.png[/img]  
[list]
[*] Top - Before Improvement  
[*] Bottom - After Improvement  
[/list]

[h3][b]Settings Save Issue Resolved[/b][/h3]
An issue where changes to settings were not being saved has been fixed. Your settings will now be saved as expected.

[h3][b]Default Color Mode Adjustment[/b][/h3]
The default color mode now aligns with your Windows system theme.  
If you manually change the color mode in the settings, your preferences will be applied.

[h3][b]Additional Resolution Support (16:9 Aspect Ratio)[/b][/h3]
We’ve expanded resolution support to include more 16:9 aspect ratios, in addition to the previously supported UHD, QHD, and HD resolutions.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/dcdd949c85cb771db77d6fb8a99c594c9a7873cd.png[/img]

[h3][b]Jio Character Animation Rigging Fixes[/b][/h3]
We’ve improved the animation rigging for Jio, the male default character, to address issues with awkward posing.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/de70353b1eb4bb0cfa87b89e2219708ae8b90a63.png[/img]  
[list]
[*] Left - Before Fix  
[*] Right - After Fix  
[/list]

[h3][b]Bibi Character Ankle Rigging Fixes[/b][/h3]
We’ve fixed an issue where ankle seams were overly prominent on certain shoes worn by Bibi, the additional female character.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/0442ba64e1ac3148b62a1b4a53250cc7a6e86656.png[/img]  
[list]
[*] Top - Before Fix  
[*] Bottom - After Fix  
[/list]

This concludes the details of this update.  
While we acknowledge there is always room for improvement, we are committed to continually enhancing and growing this project.  
Thank you for your ongoing support!

Sincerely,  
The Meta Soulmate Team

notes.title: Meta Soulmate 0.1.1 Minor Update and Server Maintenance Notice (Completed)
notes.content:
We would like to inform you about the upcoming minor update and server maintenance for Meta Soulmate version 0.1.1.

[h1][b]Correction of Missing Translations [/b][/h1]
Some previously missing translations have been fixed. Additional translations have been added to certain areas that were incomplete.

[h1][b]Addition of Clothing and Hair Physics On/Off Setting[/b][/h1]
A new setting has been added that allows users to turn clothing and hair physics on or off. [Insert Screenshot] This feature is helpful for users who wish to optimize their system performance or find these movements inconvenient. The default setting is On.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/112c659049311d87c45690843d40da5002404386.png[/img]
[u][b]There is currently an issue where settings are not being saved. This will be fixed in the next minor patch.[/b][/u]

[h1][b]Adjustment of Body Movement Intensity[/b][/h1]
We have adjusted parts of the body that were affected by excessive movement constants. Users who wish for stronger or less intense movements can adjust these settings in the Body > Shape menu.

[h1][b]Fit Adjustments for Certain Outfits[/b][/h1]
Meta Soulmate employs a system that allows independent replacement of outfits across different areas. Due to this system, issues involving overlapping or interference between outfits may arise. The development team has been experimenting with various solutions to minimize such interference. However, in this process, there have been cases where the fit of existing outfits has been compromised. This minor patch aims to address this issue by focusing on enhancing the fit while sacrificing some degree of interference prevention. This aspect remains an important focus for our team, and we plan to continue research and development throughout the early access period.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/a81bed730644c8c390fc9832084b731ec463eb8a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Retrieval of Incorrectly Granted Items Due to Payment Server Error[/b][/h1]
Due to a payment server error today (KST 6:50 PM), we will conduct server maintenance to retrieve items that were mistakenly granted. The maintenance is expected to last about 5 minutes, during which the application will not be accessible. If you have any inquiries following the maintenance regarding item retrieval, please visit https://store.steampowered.com/account/history/, attach a screenshot of your purchase record, and contact us at msm_help@oneunivrs.com for assistance with the next steps.

Thank you for your understanding. We strive to improve steadily and make this project better with each step.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Meta Soulmate Early Access Version 0.1.0 Release Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/73087b6848cbe86f516249b379564bc562e4d7dd.png[/img]

Hello,

This is DEV.JIN, in charge of the Meta Soulmate project. We are pleased to announce the release of Meta Soulmate’s first early access version 0.1.0. Although it was initially scheduled for October 30th, due to some oversight during the process of modifying store page options, the page was subject to review, which delayed the expected release date. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

In this early access version 0.1.0, the core focus lies on the essential elements of character customization, which form the foundation of the project, as well as the key feature for VTuber functionality—Meta Soul Link (face tracking). Additionally, we have included Meta Screen, a separate screen system supporting transparency for basic broadcasting needs. For more detailed information on these features, please refer to the [url=https://metasoulmate.com/]Meta Soulmate Wiki[/url], which is currently available in Korean only, but we plan to add English support soon. Other languages will also be added in sequence based on the application’s supported languages.

Starting with version 0.1.0, the Meta Soulmate project will implement monetization through memberships and additional character purchases. We fully anticipate and understand concerns and criticisms regarding charging for some functions and content at the early access stage. However, in order to reach the complete 1.0 version of this project, we need time, and during that time, a minimal level of funding is necessary. To maintain and complete the project, we made the difficult decision to introduce monetization. Nevertheless, we have set the minimum standards to balance user affordability and maintain the current state of our team, as shown below:

[list]
[*] Membership: $9.99 per month, or $59.94 annually with a 50% discount.
[*] Additional character purchases: The main protagonist characters (male and female) are provided for free. Other character body types can be purchased once for permanent ownership at $19.99.
[/list]

We chose a membership policy as a way to provide users with various options while minimizing their financial burden. The membership allows unrestricted access to all features, excluding additional character purchases. During initial discussions on monetization, a costume-based charging model, commonly seen in other services, was suggested. However, envisioning users preparing for broadcasts by changing costumes multiple times led us to conclude that an all-access membership policy would be more suitable for our project. Non-members can still use most functions with certain limitations and are able to broadcast.

This is our first step. While we acknowledge there are areas that need improvement, we remain open to user feedback and are driven by clear goals and dedication. We promise once again that this project will be built with your input and collaboration.

The 0.1.1 minor patch, which will include functional adjustments and bug fixes, is scheduled for the first week of November 2024.

Thank you.

notes.title: Schedule Announcement After Steam Next Fest February 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/5ec95930b8abcac42d353e737051dca6e9440265.png[/img]
  b]Thanks to your tremendous support, we have successfully concluded the first journey of MSM Maker at the Steam Next Fest in February 2024! We extend our heartfelt gratitude once again. ːsteamthumbsupː[/b]

We would like to provide some updates regarding the future schedule of MSM Maker.

[h1]Demo Download Schedule[/h1]
The demo will be available for download [b]until February (KST)[/b] and will be removed afterward. This is to prevent any potential issues due to significant differences that may arise between the demo and the upcoming Early Access version. However, should a new demo be developed that can be effectively managed alongside the Early Access version, we will reopen the demo for download.

[h1]Official Discord Launch Schedule[/h1]
The official Discord channel will serve as a transparent communication platform where we can share development updates with you all. We plan to launch the channel [b]within February[/b], and will notify you through the Steam page banner and announcements once the Discord is established.

[h1]Regarding the Early Access Schedule[/h1]
As mentioned during the live session, the exact schedule for Early Access has not been set yet. However, we anticipate it could be [b]as early as Q2 or at the latest by Q3[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815820/78b9be06fa7435be57b6e3617ae65bec4d0d89f8.png[/img]

[b]Let's meet again when it gets warmer![/b]
